Every button now shows its symbol, the desktop app brings yt-dlp and ffmpeg along and draws its own title bar, and long multi-part archives unpack again.

## ✨ Added

- **Solvecha as a seventh captcha account.** It reads picture captchas only, so reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile and click captchas go on to the next account. It is tried once its key is saved on the Accounts page. Thanks to @userlip for adding it. ([#133](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/pull/133))
- **A note when the clipboard watch catches links.** The desktop app pops it up at the edge of the screen, even from the tray, and says how many links went into the link collector and from which site. A click on it opens the collector. Under Watch the clipboard in Settings, Link collector you choose whether it shows, how long it stays and where.
- **yt-dlp and ffmpeg come with the desktop app.** A YouTube link opens into its video, audio and other rows right after installing, and videos arrive with picture and sound joined. Settings, Resolvers names the ffmpeg build and links to its source.
- **Each link shows what kind of file it is,** in the link collector and on Downloads, with a symbol for video, audio, image, subtitles, text, archive or any other file.
- **"Don't show again" is a checkbox.** Notices and questions you can switch off have a box for it, and Settings, General, Silenced questions and notices brings them back.

## 🎨 Design

- **The desktop app draws its own title bar on Windows and Linux,** in your theme and corner shape, with its own buttons to minimise, maximise and close. On macOS the window keeps its usual title bar.
- **Every button shows its symbol,** 130 more than before, and Labels in Settings, Appearance now reaches all of them: Symbol shows the symbol alone, Text the words alone.
- **Clearer symbols.** Try again, Restart and Refresh get an arrow of their own, Downloads a plain arrow, the link collector a magnifying glass, Sleep and Quiet mode a Zzz and Check for updates a cloud. The choices under Labels and Row height have symbols too.
- **A row's buttons stand at its right edge** in the link collector and on Downloads, with Remove always last. Under the pointer they light up in colour instead of getting a grey square.
- **The two link notices look alike.** "Links not added" and "Rejected links" count in words and list each link with its reason in your language, with Restore at the end of its row.
- **Rename shows the whole name** in a wider window.
- **The cards on the Instances page are all the same size** and always show the name in full. Every device in the picture of the group wears the KnightLoader logo, with a small badge for what it is.
- **On a narrow phone the bottom bar shows its symbols alone,** a size larger.
- **The overview's cards wiggle while you customise it,** to show that they can be moved.
- **Version numbers show without a "v".**

## ⚡ Improved

- **Packages arrive on Downloads folded,** and one you opened stays open.
- **Removing downloads asks about the files with a switch.** It starts off, so the files stay on disk unless you turn it on. Deleting files no longer needs the login password.
- **The link collector drops its Enabled column.** Enable and Disable are in the right-click menu, and the availability column is called Status, as on Downloads.
- **A failure's bubble is short.** It says what failed and what you can do, and the full message is in the row's details.
- **Tab stays inside an open window,** and closing the window puts the focus back on the button that opened it.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Long multi-part archives unpack again.** In a set like `name.part01.rar` with a name longer than about 100 characters, shortening the name cut off the `.part01`, so the parts were saved as `name.rar`, `name (2).rar` and so on, and unpacking failed. The part number now stays.
- **A closed desktop app stays in your group.** It keeps its card on the Instances page as Inactive until you remove it, and the Pairing page, the Android app and the browser extension show it the same way.
- **Every instance of a group lists the same phones and browsers,** also one that was closed while a device joined or left. The Android app picks up new and renamed instances by itself.
- **The browser extension takes its instance's look every time it opens,** without pressing Refresh.
- **The Windows installer closes a running KnightLoader before it updates it,** and starting KnightLoader a second time brings the open window forward.
- **KnightLoader Test keeps its own data** in `%APPDATA%\KnightLoader Test`.
- **A YouTube link splits into its rows again** when JDownloader sits above yt-dlp on the priority card.
- **Start all no longer flickers** with many links in the link collector.
- **The Android app's background notice stays put** instead of popping up again on every check.
- **Cancel looks like a button** in every window.
- **Smaller fixes:** instance cards no longer flash red while loading, every device shows in the picture of the group at every width, the link collector's totals no longer overlap in a narrow window, the link list reaches the bottom of the window, and the installer's folder chooser no longer dims the desktop on Windows.
